description: Secretariat Office of Prime Minister - Amended Extraordinary Gazette No 2281/41 Dated 27.05.2022, Duties and Functions of the Defence Minister, Further  Amended 14th 07.2022.
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Ranil Wickremesinghe) as Prime Minister and provides extensive detailed portfolio responsibilities for the Minister of Defence position, including duties & functions, departments/institutions under purview, and laws to be implemented. The content contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
